en: A single fixed pulley only changes the direction of the effort force, rather than reducing the amount of force needed to lift a heavy bucket.
Fluid friction, like air resistance, slows down a falling skydiver's parachute even though the parachute is moving through a gas instead of a solid.
Without air resistance in a vacuum, a heavy bowling ball and a light feather fall at the exact same speed toward the ground.
A magnet will attract an iron nail but will not attract an aluminum soda can because aluminum is not a ferromagnetic metal.
A battery does not store electricity; instead, it stores chemical energy that transforms into electrical energy when connected to a complete circuit.
Light does not travel instantly, but moves at a specific speed of 300,000 kilometers per second, taking about eight minutes to reach Earth from the Sun.
Sound cannot travel through the vacuum of outer space because it requires a physical medium, like air or water, to vibrate and move.
When cooling a room, thermal energy actually flows out of the warm indoor air into the cooler outside air, rather than coldness flowing in.
When a moving bicycle applies its brakes, its kinetic energy is not destroyed but transforms into thermal energy that heats up the brake pads.
A wheelbarrow is a second-class lever because its load rests in the middle between the wheel fulcrum and the handles where you apply effort.
The geographic North Pole of Earth is actually a magnetic south pole, which is why it attracts the north-seeking pole of a compass needle.
A white piece of paper does not absorb light; instead, it reflects all colors of visible light back to your eyes.
